items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: Well, she worked with me for awhile. I got a chance to play with her nights.

ctx.x: Did she work alone or did she have a rhythm section with her?

Worked alone. Well, she worked with me for awhile. I got a chance to play with her nights. And I was glad to play with her because she was teaching me a lot of things. Sure, I got a chance to learn a lot.
